add-actualtext-to-images.title: Add ActualText Alt Text to Images in a Tagged PDF
add-actualtext-to-images.description: Demonstrates how to create Figure elements for images in a PDF, set their AlternativeText (mapped to /ActualText for screen‑readers), and save the document as a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-caption-note-to-figure.title: Add Caption Note to Figure in Tagged PDF
add-caption-note-to-figure.description: The example loads a PDF, enables tagged PDF features, creates a figure element with alternative text, adds a note element as a caption under the figure, and saves the modified document.

add-custom-tag-to-paragraph.title: Add Custom Tag to Paragraph in Tagged PDF
add-custom-tag-to-paragraph.description: Shows how to create a paragraph element in a tagged PDF, assign a custom tag name, set its text, and attach it to the structure tree using Aspose.Pdf.

add-internal-page-link-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Internal Page Link Annotation to PDF
add-internal-page-link-to-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a link annotation that navigates to another page within the same PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-note-element-to-paragraph.title: Add Note Element to Paragraph in Tagged PDF
add-note-element-to-paragraph.description: Shows how to create a note element and attach it as a child of a paragraph in a tagged PDF to provide supplemental information for accessibility.

add-page-break-to-tagged-pdf.title: Add Page Break to Tagged PDF Logical Structure
add-page-break-to-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a page‑break element into the logical structure tree of a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-textbox-form-field-tagged-pdf.title: Add Tagged Form Field and Structure Element to PDF
add-textbox-form-field-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a text box form field, register it in the AcroForm, and link it to a /Form structure element for PDF accessibility tagging.

append-paragraph-actualtext-to-toci.title: Append Paragraph with ActualText to TOCI in Tagged PDF
append-paragraph-actualtext-to-toci.description: Demonstrates creating a TOCI placeholder in a PDF's logical structure, adding a paragraph element beneath it, and setting the ActualText property to improve accessibility using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-tagged-pdfa.title: Batch Convert PDFs to Tagged PDFs with Auto‑Tagging
batch-convert-pdfs-to-tagged-pdfa.description: Shows how to iterate over a folder of untagged PDF files, enable Aspose.Pdf auto‑tagging, set language and title for accessibility, and save the resulting tagged PDFs to a separate output directory.

batch-pdfa1b-validation-xml-logs-dashboa.title: Batch PDF Validation with XML Logs and HTML Dashboard
batch-pdfa1b-validation-xml-logs-dashboa.description: Processes all PDFs in a folder, checks basic compliance, saves an XML log for each file, and generates an HTML dashboard summarizing compliance percentages.

batch-tag-pdfs-with-suffix.title: Batch Auto‑Tag PDFs and Save with Suffix
batch-tag-pdfs-with-suffix.description: Processes all PDF files in a folder, enables Aspose.Pdf auto‑tagging, adds basic structure elements when missing, sets language and title metadata, and saves each file with a configurable suffix.

batch-validate-pdfs-summary-csv.title: Batch PDF Validation with XML Logs and CSV Summary
batch-validate-pdfs-summary-csv.description: Iterates through a folder of PDF files, validates each using Aspose.Pdf, creates an XML log for every file, and produces a CSV summary of the validation results.

check-pdf-ua-compliance-and-log.title: Check PDF/UA Compliance and Log Result
check-pdf-ua-compliance-and-log.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically validate a PDF against PDF/UA‑1 using Aspose.Pdf and output the boolean compliance result.

create-nested-bullet-numbered-lists-tagg.title: Create Nested Bullet and Numbered List in PDF
create-nested-bullet-numbered-lists-tagg.description: Demonstrates how to build a PDF with an outer bullet list that contains an indented numbered sub‑list using Aspose.Pdf, and validates the list structure.

create-pdf-with-heading-and-language.title: Create Tagged PDF with Heading and Language Attribute
create-pdf-with-heading-and-language.description: Shows how to create a new PDF, enable tagged PDF, set the document language, add an H1 heading element with its own language attribute, and save the file.

create-tagged-3x4-table-in-pdf.title: Add a 3×4 Table to a Tagged PDF
create-tagged-3x4-table-in-pdf.description: Shows how to create a three‑row by four‑column table in a tagged PDF, set alternative text for accessibility, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

create-tagged-pdf-table-with-merged-head.title: Create Tagged Table Header with TH Role and ActualText
create-tagged-pdf-table-with-merged-head.description: The example loads a PDF, enables tagged PDF support, creates a table structure with a header row, assigns the TH role to header cells, and sets the /ActualText attribute for each header.

create-tagged-pdf-with-toc.title: Create Tagged Table of Contents in PDF
create-tagged-pdf-with-toc.description: Demonstrates how to add a visual Table of Contents page and corresponding logical heading structure to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API for accessibility.

create-tagged-table-with-custom-tags.title: Tag Table Cells with Custom Data Types in a PDF
create-tagged-table-with-custom-tags.description: Demonstrates creating a tagged PDF, adding a table structure, and assigning custom data‑type tags to header and data cells using the AlternativeText property.

custom-table-cell-borders-by-row-index.title: Apply Custom Border Styles to PDF Table Cells
custom-table-cell-borders-by-row-index.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a PDF and set different border widths and colors for cells based on the row index, enhancing visual distinction.

enable-auto-tagging-save-tagged-pdf.title: Automatic PDF/UA Tagging and Save
enable-auto-tagging-save-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to enable Aspose.Pdf automatic tagging (PDF/UA conversion), set the document language and title, and save the file as a tagged, accessible PDF.

export-pdf-structure-tree-to-json.title: Export PDF Structure Tree to JSON
export-pdf-structure-tree-to-json.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, traverse its logical structure tree, and serialize the hierarchy to a JSON file for accessibility analysis.

export-structure-tree-to-xml-xsl-report.title: Export PDF Structure Tree to XML and Generate Report via XSLT
export-structure-tree-to-xml-xsl-report.description: Shows how to export a PDF's logical structure tree to an XML file using Aspose.Pdf and then transform that XML with XSLT to produce an HTML report.

export-tagged-pdf-content-to-json.title: Export Tagged PDF Content to JSON
export-tagged-pdf-content-to-json.description: Shows how to read a PDF's logical (tagged) structure with Aspose.Pdf, build a hierarchical DTO, and serialize the hierarchy to a JSON file.

extract-notes-from-tagged-pdf.title: Extract PDF Note Annotations to Text File
extract-notes-from-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a PDF, collect all TextAnnotation (note) contents, concatenate them, and save the result as a plain text file.

extract-pdf-links-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Links to CSV
extract-pdf-links-to-csv.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through pages and link annotations, collect the destination URLs, and write them to a CSV file.

extract-text-from-tagged-pdf-structure.title: Extract Text from Tagged PDF Structure Tree
extract-text-from-tagged-pdf-structure.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, verify that it is tagged, and recursively traverse its structure tree to retrieve visible and alternative text from each element.

filter-xml-missing-alt-text.title: Extract Image IDs with Missing Alt Text from Validation XML
filter-xml-missing-alt-text.description: Loads an XML validation report, filters errors that indicate missing alternative text, and outputs a distinct list of affected image IDs.

iterate-tagged-pdf-structure-elements.title: Iterate Tagged PDF Structure Elements and Log Details
iterate-tagged-pdf-structure-elements.description: The example loads a PDF, accesses its tagged content, and recursively walks the structure tree to output each element's tag name, language, and title (ActualText).

nested-table-in-paragraph-tagged-pdf.title: Create Nested Table Inside Paragraph and Validate Tagging Hierarchy
nested-table-in-paragraph-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to add a paragraph containing an outer table with a nested table using Aspose.Pdf's tagging API, then walks the structure to verify the correct hierarchy.

propagate-language-attribute-to-tagged-p.title: Propagate Language Attribute in Tagged PDF
propagate-language-attribute-to-tagged-p.description: Shows how to set a default language on the root structure element of a tagged PDF and recursively propagate it to all descendant elements using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-note-element-in-tagged-pdf.title: Replace Existing Note Annotation in PDF
replace-note-element-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to locate a text annotation by its title, remove it, and add a new note annotation with updated title and contents using Aspose.Pdf.

set-actualtext-span-pronunciation.title: Set ActualText on a Span for Pronunciation in a Tagged PDF
set-actualtext-span-pronunciation.description: Shows how to create a tagged PDF, add a span element with visible text and hidden pronunciation using the ActualText property, and save the document.

set-figure-title-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Figure Title (Alternative Text) in Tagged PDF
set-figure-title-in-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to locate or create a FigureElement in a PDF's tagged structure and assign its AlternativeText property to provide a concise description for accessibility.

set-missing-language-attributes.title: Set Language Attribute for All Tagged PDF Structure Elements
set-missing-language-attributes.description: Shows how to assign a default language (e.g., en-US) to a PDF's tagged content and propagate it to every structure element using Aspose.Pdf, handling library version differences via reflection.

set-paragraph-title-in-tagged-pdf.title: Set Paragraph Title in Tagged PDF for Accessibility
set-paragraph-title-in-tagged-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a paragraph to a PDF's logical structure and assign a Title attribute for accessibility using Aspose.Pdf.

set-primary-language-for-tagged-pdf.title: Add Language Attribute to PDF Structure Tree
set-primary-language-for-tagged-pdf.description: Shows how to set the primary language for a PDF's tagged structure tree using Aspose.Pdf, ensuring accessibility metadata is applied.

set-root-structure-element-title.title: Set Document Title in Tagged PDF
set-root-structure-element-title.description: Demonstrates how to set the document title and language metadata for a tagged PDF and add a paragraph via the root structure element using Aspose.Pdf.

style-table-cells-background-border-padd.title: Style Table Cells with Background, Border, and Padding
style-table-cells-background-border-padd.description: Shows how to create a PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and apply background color, border thickness, and padding to each cell to improve visual accessibility.

summarize-pdf-validation-errors.title: Parse XML Validation Report for Error Summary
summarize-pdf-validation-errors.description: Shows how to load an XML validation report, group errors by their code attribute, and display the most frequent violation messages using LINQ.

update-paragraph-actualtext-in-tagged-pd.title: Update Paragraph ActualText in a Tagged PDF
update-paragraph-actualtext-in-tagged-pd.description: Loads a tagged PDF, finds a paragraph by its title (using AlternativeText or ActualText), updates the paragraph's ActualText for accessibility correction, and saves the modified document.

update-tagged-element-language-french.title: Update Language Property of Tagged PDF Element to French
update-tagged-element-language-french.description: Shows how to load a tagged PDF, locate a paragraph element, set its Language property to French (fr-FR), and save the document, triggering revalidation of accessibility compliance.

validate-pdf-ua-compliance-export-xml.title: Validate PDF/UA Compliance and Generate XML Report
validate-pdf-ua-compliance-export-xml.description: Loads a PDF, checks if it is tagged, runs PDF/UA validation using Aspose.Pdf, and writes an XML compliance report.
